_doc: Owner approvals that gate PUBLIC output. Every value is false until the owner records it here (with who and when). Packages for public hosting (scripts/make-wix-package.mjs, FM_PUBLIC=1) withhold anything whose approval is false, and production builds are blocked. Nothing in this file has been granted by Claude.

nvidiaBranding.approvedBy: site owner (explicit instruction in the working session)
nvidiaBranding.covers: NVIDIA Inception badge, the 'Inception Member' panel, the IOSutra membership statement, the non-endorsement statement and the NVIDIA trademark attribution, shown inside the IOSutra advertisement only, using the existing approved design and original assets.
notDocumented: Membership has not been independently verified in the NVIDIA Inception portal (claim stays 'owner-asserted' in data/promos.json).
NVIDIA's Inception-specific brand guidelines and required attribution wording have not been supplied or confirmed (trademark notice stays 'needs-confirmation').

iosutraPromotion.approvedBy: site owner (explicit instruction in the working session)
iosutraPromotion.covers: The existing IOSutra promotion exactly as implemented (homepage section, footer line, /technology/ page, link to iosutra.com). In production it is published WITHOUT any unverified NVIDIA claim and WITHOUT artwork whose rights are not approved (see launchPolicy and the artwork entries).
iosutraPromotion.quote: Owner instruction of 2026-11-03: 'Preserve the IOSutra promotion as currently implemented, unless a specific legal or technical issue prevents release.'

iosutraArtworkRights.approvedBy: site owner (explicit instruction in the working session)
iosutraArtworkRights.covers: The meditating man and robot picture and the IOSutra logo panel, as supplied by the owner (assets-src/partner/).
iosutraArtworkRights.quote: Owner instruction of 2026-11-03: 'Restore the original IOSutra branding and official NVIDIA Inception badge using the supplied assets ... Also investigate and restore the original Digital Librarian face beside every search bar.'
iosutraArtworkRights.limits: Recorded from the owner's instruction to restore the supplied assets. Claude has not independently verified licence or likeness permissions; the owner is responsible for them.

librarianArtworkRights.covers: The Digital Librarian character artwork (assets-src/librarian/librarian.webp), shown whole in the floating guide and as a face beside every search bar.
librarianArtworkRights.quote: Owner instruction of 2026-11-03: 'Restore the original IOSutra branding and official NVIDIA Inception badge using the supplied assets ... Also investigate and restore the original Digital Librarian face beside every search bar.'
librarianArtworkRights.limits: Recorded from the owner's instruction to restore the supplied asset. Claude has not independently verified licence or provenance; the owner is responsible for them.

legalPagesReviewed.approvedBy: site owner (explicit instruction in the working session)
legalPagesReviewed.quote: Owner instruction of 2026-11-03: 'Proceed with the Forbidden Mantra Press legal-page updates using these approved details ... Update the legal pages, run all production and launch checks, and prepare the production ZIP. Do not deploy yet.'
legalPagesReviewed.details: Operator Ravi A. Kissoon operating as Forbidden Mantra Press; public contact officialravshiva@gmail.com; governing law New York, USA; disputes contact first then applicable courts, no mandatory arbitration; minimum age 18 for independent use; not directed at children under 13; effective November 3, 2026; no analytics at launch; fonts self-hosted.
legalPagesReviewed.limits: Recorded so the production ZIP can be PREPARED. The page text was drafted by Claude from those details and is not legal advice or counsel-reviewed. The owner's read-through of the finished text is still required before the ZIP is deployed (config/site.json legal.finalTextReview).

amazonHostedCovers.withdrawnBy: site owner (explicit instruction: protect the Associates and Influencer accounts; no uncertain licensing risk)
amazonHostedCovers.note: Amazon-hosted cover images (constructed m.media-amazon.com URLs) were removed from the code. This entry is kept only as a record; nothing reads it as a switch.

launchPolicy.approvedBy: site owner (explicit instruction in the working session)
launchPolicy.quote: Owner instruction of 2026-11-03: 'Do not publish unverified NVIDIA membership or endorsement claims. If their approval cannot be established, omit or neutralize only the unverified claim rather than blocking the entire launch.'
launchPolicy.effect: A production build leaves out the NVIDIA Inception badge, the 'Inception Member' tile, the membership statement, the non-endorsement/trademark lines and the NVIDIA link while data/promos.json claims are not verified; the IOSutra promotion stays, with the line 'IOSutra is a separate product from Forbidden Mantra Press.' Artwork (IOSutra picture, Digital Librarian character) is left out of a production build while iosutraArtworkRights / librarianArtworkRights are not approved; the surrounding sections and the Digital Librarian keep working. To publish them later, record the evidence/approval and rebuild.
launchPolicy.note: 2026-11-03: the owner stated that IOSutra's NVIDIA Inception membership is verified, so the membership claim is no longer withheld. The policy still withholds any other unverified NVIDIA membership or endorsement claim.
